title: The School Lunch Pizza of the 1980s
description: A nostalgic recreation of the classic rectangular school lunch pizza from the 1980s, featuring a unique pourable crust.
steps: Mix water with flour, powdered milk, salt, sugar, yeast, and vegetable oil to create the pourable pizza crust.
Pour the batter onto a tray that has been dusted with cornmeal.
Pre-bake the crust in the oven.
Make a sauce by combining tomato paste, dried onions, garlic, and herbs.
Spread the sauce on top of the pre-baked crust.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese all the way to the very end of the crust.
Bake until finished, then cut into rectangles.
notes:
The recipe is from Quantity Recipes for School Food Service from the USDA.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/18AsnhPB9Y/
